_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Green Gloop#000.src: However, the slimes have gotten stronger about a month ago. I'm unable to retrieve it any more, I^ve come close to getting killed a few times!

Green Gloop#001.src: I'll need [{~} Slimey Goo] since we'll need a big batch of drinks. If you help, I'll be sure to tell my friend, and he^ll probably let you into his shop.

Green Gloop#002.src: Ah, you've got the scooper! Head into the cave now - remember, I need [{~} Slimey Goo] to make the drink!

Green Gloop#004.src: Oh, hey! You, adventurer over there! Would you mind helping me?
Green Gloop#004.dst: 오, 저기요! 거기 모험가님! 좀 도와주실래요?
Green Gloop#004.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#005.src: You see, this cave behind me has been troubling me for the past while now.
Green Gloop#005.dst: 그게, 제 뒤에 있는 이 동굴 때문에 요즘 골치가 아파요.
Green Gloop#005.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#006.src: There are special slimes that live in there, and they drop a certain goo that is quite a delicacy when brewed into a drink!
Green Gloop#006.dst: 안에 특별한 슬라임이 사는데, 걔들이 떨구는 끈적이를 음료로 우리면 꽤 별미거든요!
Green Gloop#006.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#007.src: They are called Gooey Slimes, and should be at the very back. A friend of mine drinks the stuff like water, and he refuses to work without it.
Green Gloop#007.dst: 끈적 슬라임이라고 하는데, 맨 안쪽에 있을 거예요. 제 친구가 그걸 물처럼 마시는데, 그게 없으면 일을 안 하겠대요.
Green Gloop#007.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#008.src: However, the slimes have gotten stronger about a month ago. I'm unable to retrieve it any more, I've come close to getting killed a few times!
Green Gloop#008.dst: 그런데 한 달쯤 전부터 슬라임들이 강해졌어요. 더는 못 구하겠어요, 몇 번이나 죽을 뻔했다고요!
Green Gloop#008.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#009.src: You, however, seem much better equipped than I. Hopefully you can do it.
Green Gloop#009.dst: 그래도 모험가님은 저보다 장비가 훨씬 좋아 보여요. 해내실 수 있길 바라요.
Green Gloop#009.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#010.src: If you decide to help me, you'll need to obtain a special device for retrieving it, as the slime will dry up quickly in the air.
Green Gloop#010.dst: 도와주실 거라면 채집용 특수 도구가 필요해요. 끈적이는 공기에 닿으면 금방 말라 버리거든요.
Green Gloop#010.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#011.src: A...less fickle glassblower, Yodbon, can make it for you. He should be living in a house in front of the {p} bank.
Green Gloop#011.dst: 좀... 덜 까다로운 유리공 Yodbon이 만들어 줄 거예요. {p} 은행 앞 집에 살고 있을 거예요.
Green Gloop#011.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#012.src: I'll need [{~} Slimey Goo] since we'll need a big batch of drinks. If you help, I'll be sure to tell my friend, and he'll probably let you into his shop.
Green Gloop#012.dst: 음료를 잔뜩 만들어야 해서 [{~} Slimey Goo]가 필요해요. 도와주시면 친구한테 꼭 말할게요. 아마 가게에 들여보내 줄 거예요.
Green Gloop#012.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#013.src: Find Yodbon near the {p} Bank at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Green Gloop#014.src: Welcome to Yodbon's Glass Blowery, what can I do f-
Green Gloop#014.dst: Yodbon 유리 공방에 어서 오세요, 뭘 도와드-
Green Gloop#014.speaker: Yodbon

Green Gloop#016.src: So many've been coming up to me recently, askin' for a bloody Slime Scooper...
Green Gloop#016.dst: 요즘 죄다 나한테 와서 빌어먹을 슬라임 국자를 달라더군...
Green Gloop#016.speaker: Yodbon

Green Gloop#017.src: Izzat brother o' mine stopped workin' again? I swear, he's addicted to that slop...
Green Gloop#017.dst: 내 동생 놈이 또 일 안 하냐? 진짜, 그 녀석 그 꿀꿀이죽에 중독됐다니까...
Green Gloop#017.speaker: Yodbon

Green Gloop#018.src: Anyways, for me to make you a scooper you'll need to get [{~} Soft Sand].
Green Gloop#018.dst: 아무튼, 국자를 만들어 주려면 [{~} Soft Sand]를 구해 와야 해.
Green Gloop#018.speaker: Yodbon

Green Gloop#019.src: Come back to me once you've gotten ahold of it. You can dig it up from those sand piles 'round the desert.
Green Gloop#019.dst: 구하면 다시 와. 사막 여기저기 있는 모래 더미에서 파낼 수 있어.
Green Gloop#019.speaker: Yodbon

Green Gloop#020.src: Bring [{~} Soft Sand] from enemies in the desert to Yodbon at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Green Gloop#020.dst: 사막의 적에게서 [{~} Soft Sand]를 얻어 [{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 Yodbon에게 가져가세요

Green Gloop#022.src: A'ight, fork 'em over and I'll make you the scooper.
Green Gloop#022.speaker: Yodbon

Green Gloop#023.src: ..There you go. No idea why he wants that stuff though. Maybe it's an acquired taste...
Green Gloop#023.dst: ..자, 여기. 걔가 왜 그걸 찾는지 모르겠네. 먹다 보면 맛들이는 건가...
Green Gloop#023.speaker: Yodbon

Green Gloop#025.src: Fetch [{~} Slimey Goo] for Eluzterp from the cave at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Green Gloop#025.dst: [{~} Slimey Goo]를 [{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 동굴에서 구해 Eluzterp에게 가져가세요

Green Gloop#026.src: Oh, you're back! Good to see you were able to get through there. Have you got a full Slime Scooper?
Green Gloop#026.dst: 오, 돌아오셨네요! 무사히 다녀오셔서 다행이에요. 슬라임 국자는 가득 채우셨어요?
Green Gloop#026.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#027.src: Hmm, yes, everything seems to be in order. Perfect!
Green Gloop#027.dst: 음, 네, 다 괜찮아 보이네요. 완벽해요!
Green Gloop#027.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#028.src: Thank you very much. Finally, I'll be able to get him in gear again... Why are all Villagers so fickle like that?
Green Gloop#028.dst: 정말 고마워요. 드디어 그 녀석을 다시 일하게 만들 수 있겠어요... 주민들은 왜 다 저렇게 변덕스러울까요?
Green Gloop#028.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#029.src: Well, I suppose that's beside the point. I'll be sure to let him know you got him his most recent fix.
Green Gloop#029.dst: 뭐, 그건 중요한 게 아니죠. 이번 물량을 모험가님이 구해 줬다고 꼭 전할게요.
Green Gloop#029.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#030.src: He hangs around in a little black stall in the bazaar, there's a basement to it. He should let you inside now.
Green Gloop#030.dst: 시장의 작고 검은 가판대에 늘 있는데, 거기 지하실이 있어요. 이제 들여보내 줄 거예요.
Green Gloop#030.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#031.src: And, for your troubles, a little something from me as well.
Green Gloop#031.dst: 그리고 수고하셨으니 제가 드리는 작은 선물이에요.
Green Gloop#031.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#032.src: Ah, hello again. This latest batch of drinks apparently really revitalized him. He said he's looking to make some great craft.
Green Gloop#032.dst: 아, 또 뵙네요. 이번 음료가 그 녀석을 정말 되살렸나 봐요. 대단한 물건을 만들어 보겠대요.
Green Gloop#032.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#033.src: Those Villagers are a little bit crazy though... I have no idea what kind of material it is that he insists he needs for it.
Green Gloop#033.dst: 그래도 주민들은 좀 이상하다니까요... 그걸 만드는 데 꼭 필요하다는 재료가 뭔지 전혀 모르겠어요.
Green Gloop#033.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#034.src: Oh, it's you again. Yes, my brother there just loves makin' his little trinkets. He oughta make somethin' useful out of his glass instead...
Green Gloop#034.dst: 아, 또 너냐. 그래, 내 동생은 자잘한 장신구 만드는 걸 아주 좋아하지. 그 유리로 쓸모 있는 거나 만들 것이지...
Green Gloop#034.speaker: Yodbon
